"""Multi-timescale (mts) decay on top of the dual-lag cat2 SDSM memory -- arm
``t2-p5-sdsm-cat2-c4096-mts``.

tasks/trident2_beat_semiring_campaign_2026-09-09.md coordinator steer for this
rung: the SDSM arm family beats the semiring bar on gMQAR/BLiMP/AR curriculum but
trails on LAMBADA (best 0.52 vs bar 0.543) and induction (0.93 vs 0.996). An SSM,
router, softmax, or surprise gate would close that gap but is out of bounds for
this family; a fixed, non-learnable per-payload-dimension decay inside the
existing SDSM slot memory is not -- it lets the SAME 64-d payload channel hold
both "what just followed X" (fast-decaying dims, short half-life) and "what
followed X a while ago" (slow-decaying dims, long half-life) at once, without a
gate deciding between them and without adding any trainable parameter.

Decay contract, before vs after (see ``sdsm_scan_triton_mts.py``'s module
docstring for the full derivation this module builds on): before, there was no
decay at all anywhere in the base or cat2 modules -- ``decay_scales`` is accepted
syntactically but only ``(1.0,)`` (no decay) is implemented;
``sdsm_scan_triton.py``'s kernels carry no decay term. After, this module adds a
FIXED (``register_buffer``, not ``nn.Parameter`` -- zero trainable-parameter cost)
PER-PAYLOAD-DIMENSION decay vector, ``(payload_dim,)``, log-spaced across
half-lives ``min_half_life`` to ``max_half_life`` tokens (default 8 to 1024) over
the ``payload_dim`` (default 64) dims of the payload channel. It is NOT scalar,
NOT per-code, and NOT per-token: one decay value per payload dimension, applied to
every code row and every timestep identically. Because ``SparseDistributedSlotMemoryCat2``
already calls the (overridable) ``self._causal_scan`` once per lag channel with the
SAME shared method, and both channels use the same ``payload_dim``, one decay
buffer suffices for both the lag-1 and lag-2 channels; each channel's scan state
decays independently (the two channels' states are never mixed until the
post-scan ``torch.cat``), so lag-1's fast/slow split and lag-2's fast/slow split
are each internally complete.

Why override only ``_causal_scan`` and nothing else: ``SparseDistributedSlotMemoryCat2.forward``
(inherited here unchanged) calls ``self._causal_scan(write_mask_l1, v1, read_mask,
chunk_size)`` and ``self._causal_scan(write_mask_l2, v2, read_mask, chunk_size)``
polymorphically -- both already route through whatever ``_causal_scan`` this
subclass defines, so no other line of ``forward`` needs to change to thread the
decay buffer through both channels.

Parameter count: ``self.decay`` is a buffer, not a parameter -- ``sum(p.numel()
for p in module.parameters())`` is IDENTICAL to plain ``SparseDistributedSlotMemoryCat2``
at the same ``(dim, n_codes, key_dim, payload_dim)``, i.e. unchanged from cat2's
5_369_456 active parameters at the P5 geometry (``dim=304``); see
``research/tests/test_sparse_distributed_slot_memory_mts.py`` and
``test_trident2_stack.py::test_arms_have_exact_active_parameter_contracts``.
"""

"""``(payload_dim,)`` per-step multiplicative decay factors whose half-lives
    are log-spaced from ``min_half_life`` to ``max_half_life`` tokens.

    Dim 0 decays fastest (half-life ``min_half_life``); the last dim decays
    slowest (half-life ``max_half_life``). ``decay = 0.5 ** (1 / half_life)`` is
    the per-token multiplier such that ``decay ** half_life == 0.5`` exactly --
    the definition of half-life. ``torch.logspace`` with ``base=2`` spaces the
    half-lives evenly in log2-space, e.g. for the default (8, 1024, 64 dims) the
    half-lives run ``8, ~8.36, ..., 1024`` -- log-spaced, not linear, so both the
    fast and slow ends of the range keep comparable relative resolution.
    """

"""``SparseDistributedSlotMemoryCat2`` with a fixed, per-payload-dim decay
    threaded through both lag channels' causal scan.

    See the module docstring for the decay contract and why only
    ``_causal_scan`` needs overriding.
    """

super().__init__(
            dim,
            n_codes=n_codes,
            active=active,
            key_dim=key_dim,
            payload_dim=payload_dim,
            decay_scales=decay_scales,
            tie_addressing=tie_addressing,
        )

"""Overrides the base module's undecayed scan dispatch with the
        decay-aware kernel from ``sdsm_scan_triton_mts``. Signature and return
        (reads only, ``(B, L, payload_dim)``) match the base method exactly --
        ``forward`` (inherited from ``SparseDistributedSlotMemoryCat2``) is
        unaware anything changed."""
